header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH,
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
None present for the petitioner nor any intimation is received. This
body: petition was filed in the year 2024 and listed before this Court for hearing. Perusal of prayer clauses, it reflects that petitioner is only seeking protection. Therefore, the petition is disposed of alongwith listed application, with directions to the official respondents to act strictly in accordance with law. The petition is disposed of in the above terms.
